economy.scenarioMetadataNote: V4 continuous pricing uses the fixed formula below; declared category bands and per-class yields are legacy scenario metadata and do not set current V4 prices or income.
economy.effectiveFormula: basePriceM = round2(clamp(25,1500,500*ln(1+marketCapUSD/50,000,000,000)/ln(5))); baseIncomeM = round2(basePriceM*(0.10+0.04*(1-exp(-marketCapUSD/200,000,000,000)))); one-share C/C price = basePriceM/5. Cap class only labels Small/Medium/Large.

marketPlaces.basis: One game company per issuer; exactly one representative listing per company where established. Geographic zone is the game company zone, not the exchange location.

marketPlaces.methodology: One representative primary or issuer-home listing per legal issuer. For dual-primary or multi-market issuers, selected venue is an editorial representative and not claimed to be exclusive. ADRs are excluded when a domestic/issuer-home line is represented. Tickers and venues marked inferred must be confirmed against the issuer or venue record before transaction use. Unknown means no defensible primary line was established.
